schedule.priority: critical chain first, then the members and ancestors of priority gates, then rank (ascending latest_start), then natural id; gate_order strict: a gate block starts when every earlier block has merged; the run starts after view:G2

assumptions: Agent hours are S=4, M=7, L=11, XL=16 unless the ticket has hours.
Each approval for a size not in autoMergeSizes is provided within 30 minutes.
Each blocking gate check is signed within 30 minutes.
Sizes in autoMergeSizes add no human wait. The default list is S, M.
Elapsed hours are the longer of the critical chain plus those waits, and agent hours divided by maxAgents.

WE-02.summary: Edit store: change log, undo and redo, unsaved count

acs.text: Given `WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/fixtures/beam.sample.json`, when a change WV-07 merged→coding is applied, then working.tickets['WV-07'].status is coding, dirty is 1 and the loaded beam still says merged.
Given two changes then undo, when redo runs, then the state equals the state after two changes and dirty is 2.
Given 55 changes, when undo runs 60 times, then only 50 are undone and the 51st-oldest change remains.
Given a frozen loaded beam, when apply runs, then nothing throws (no mutation of frozen objects).
Given `npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/app test`, when run, then store.test.mjs passes.

WE-03.summary: Phase menu: allowed targets, same-phase and unknown refused

acs.text: Given status merged, when targetsFrom runs, then it returns queued, claimed, planning, coding, review, fix, awaiting_approval, merging, blocked, alarm in that order.
Given status coding, when targetsFrom runs, then it returns the twelve other phases including merged and done.
Given from merged and to merged, when check runs, then it returns same with the message naming the ticket and the phase; skipped to skipped likewise.
Given to 'teleporting', when check runs, then it returns unknown naming 'teleporting'.
Given `npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/app test`, when run, then phases.test.mjs passes.

WE-06.summary: Confirm dialog: ticket, from and to phase, dependents, note

acs.text: Given WV-07 merged → coding with two blocked dependents, when the dialog opens, then it matches `WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/ui/screens/edit-confirm.png`.
Given a note typed and Reset clicked, when resolved, then the promise gives ok true and the note.
Given Escape, the scrim or Cancel, when pressed, then the promise gives ok false and no change reaches the store.
Given a 600-character note, when typed, then it stops at 500 characters.
Given `npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/app test`, when run, then confirm.test.mjs passes.

WE-04.summary: Reset a ticket's phase: event, reset log, timestamps kept

acs.text: Given WV-07 merged in `WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/fixtures/beam.sample.json`, when reset to coding with note 'flaky test' at 2026-10-12T19:30:00Z, then the ticket equals `WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/fixtures/expected/reset.WV-07.coding.json`.
Given the same reset, when compared field by field, then pr.mergedAt, pr.openedAt, tokens, minutes and usage are unchanged.
Given to equal to the current status, when buildReset runs, then it returns the same-phase refusal and no change.
Given a reset then revertReset, when compared with the loaded ticket, then they are deeply equal.
Given `npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/app test`, when run, then reset.test.mjs passes.

WE-07.summary: Undo, redo and unsaved count in the header

acs.text: Given one reset, when the header renders, then it matches `WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/ui/screens/edit-header.png` (1 unsaved, Undo enabled, Redo disabled).
Given Ctrl+Z then Ctrl+Shift+Z, when pressed outside inputs, then the reset is undone and redone and the count goes 1 → 0 → 1.
Given focus in the search box, when Ctrl+Z is pressed, then the browser's text undo runs and the store is unchanged.
Given zero unsaved changes, when the page unloads, then no confirmation is asked.
Given `npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/app test`, when run, then history.test.mjs passes.

WE-05.summary: Dependents of an un-merged ticket go back to blocked

acs.text: Given WV-07 merged and its queued dependents in `WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/fixtures/beam.sample.json`, when reset to coding, then exactly the ids in `WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/fixtures/expected/dependents.WV-07.json` go to blocked.
Given a dependent already coding, when planned, then it is listed with a warning and its status is unchanged.
Given reset from skipped to queued, when planned, then dependents are unchanged (skipped never unblocked them in Warp's merge sense).
Given undo of that reset, when applied, then every dependent's status equals its status before the reset.
Given `npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/app test`, when run, then dependents.test.mjs passes.

WE-08.summary: Validate before save: missing ids, cycles, reset log

acs.text: Given `WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/fixtures/beam.sample.json` unchanged, when validated, then there are no errors.
Given `WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/fixtures/invalid/missing-dep.json` (WV-09 depends on WV-99), when validated, then one error dep-missing says 'WV-09 depends on WV-99, which is not in this run'.
Given `WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/fixtures/invalid/cycle.json`, when validated, then one error cycle names 'WV-10 → WV-11 → WV-10'.
Given a dependency written view:WV-15 in the edit run, when validated, then it is not reported.
Given `npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/app test`, when run, then validate.test.mjs passes.

acs.text: Given WV-07 merged, when its drawer opens, then the Reset section matches `WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/ui/screens/edit-drawer.png`.
